claim: The llm-d-router datastore dispatches an EventAddOrUpdate notification through endpoint-notification-source only when an endpoint is first added via Runtime.NewEndpoint(), not when an existing endpoint's metadata subsequently changes.
stance_target: a custom EndpointDiscovery/datastore implementation must independently guarantee update notifications on metadata mutation, not rely on datastore defaults
scope_conditions: llm-d-router prior to PR #1404 (merged Jun 1 2026, released v0.9.0)
quoted_support: Today, when an endpoint is first added, the datastore calls Runtime.NewEndpoint(), and the runtime dispatches EventAddOrUpdate through endpoint-notification-source. However, when the same endpoint already exists and only its metadata changes, the datastore only calls Endpoint.UpdateMetadata(meta) and returns without dispatching an event.

claim: Plugins that subscribe to endpoint-notification-source, specifically precise-prefix-cache components that install or refresh per-endpoint KV-events (ZMQ) subscribers, can hold stale state when an endpoint's address/labels/rank/ports change without a dispatched notification.
stance_target: a non-k8s EndpointDiscovery plugin must fire update events on metadata change to avoid stale KV-cache-event subscriptions
quoted_support: Plugins that rely on endpoint-notification-source can miss endpoint updates. For example, precise prefix cache components use endpoint add/update events to install or refresh per-endpoint KV-events subscribers. If endpoint metadata such as address, labels, rank, or ports changes without a notification, plugin state can remain stale.

claim: The upstream fix for issue #1403 requires the datastore to dispatch EventAddOrUpdate on existing-endpoint metadata changes too, while explicitly skipping dispatch when the new metadata is identical to avoid redundant notification storms.
stance_target: correct behavior contract for any datastore/notification-source implementation, including a custom non-k8s one
quoted_support: Existing endpoint metadata changes should dispatch EventAddOrUpdate, just like endpoint additions, so endpoint-aware plugins can refresh their per-endpoint state.
